doc.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023

title: Thanks, Hamilton connections and goodbyes
summary: Closing thanks, her Hamilton in-laws, a coming Harvard residency.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you. I’ve really enjoyed this conversation. And I appreciate it and I hope that — I know you’ll keep doing what you’ve been doing.

Oh thank you so much, Monk, and I’ve got to tell you that it turns out that my sister-in- law went to Hamilton years ago, and my brother-in-law actually. So they both studied there. And I like those kind of coincidences. And I will be headed to Harvard at the end of next month to do a residency there, so I’m looking forward to that.
Awesome. Well your — I was going to say that your experience, your fifty years of experience should yield all kinds of excellent information for today’s students.
Well let’s look forward to that. I certainly hope so.
All right. Well I’ll pause and we’ll say our good-byes.
